title.narrative: Transforming education in Moldova through Model Schools

description.narrative:
The project’s main objective is Enhanced quality and effectiveness of Moldova's education system through the transformation of district schools into Model Schools. This is to be achieved through two outcomes and four outputs:
Outcome 1: Norad will support five schools which will be transformed into Model Schools with a modern learning environment and facilities enabling better learning outcomes and improved efficiency of the school network. Output 1.1: Upgraded learning environment in five Model Schools offering better education opportunities to students from Moldova Outcome 2: Facilitate the development of 21st century skills of students through transforming teaching and learning practices and improving school management. Output 2.1. Improved relevance of education through supporting the curricular reform, enhancing the quality of curricular materials and educational content Output 2.2 Enhanced quality of education through strengthening initial and continuous teachers training Output 2.3. Improved local level education governance and school management and autonomy to enhance the quality of education
In terms of enhancing local level education governance, the project will strengthen the capacity of territorial education structures at local level to implement local education policies and conduct quality assurance of the educational process, as well as collect data and roll out analytical studies for supporting evidence-based decision-making in education. The school renovations will improve accessibility of the buildings and ensure more equitable access to education for children with disabilities.
